answer: Vest each identity's earned reward across many epochs of continuous graded work rather than paying it all at once. A freshly minted clone starts with almost nothing vested and must bend with time like a young willow; only steady contribution raises it. A farm that spins up accounts for a single coordinated signal gets near zero, because unvested weight evaporates when an account goes idle — reward spirals upward only for identities that keep showing up epoch after epoch, so tenure, not head count, sets payout and a swarm of young clones cannot cash out.
